  "text": "On Sunday evening, Mara stayed late to finish the lining of a coat nobody had collected. The ticket pinned inside the collar gave a surname she could not read and a date from the week her father went into hospital.

From below came a brief metallic scrape.

Mara kept her hand on the handle until the sound stopped. Then she lifted it firmly, heard the latch settle, and switched off the workroom light.

She went home by the longer route, past the houses where people had already drawn their curtains."
